steps.name: Panicked Girl
steps.text: Andrew! Did they hit you again?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Call me Sky.

steps.name: Panicked Girl
steps.text: But you gave yourself that name. Mom and Dad said...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Don't bring them into this! What have they ever done for us, except use us as punching bags? They don't get to decide my name!

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I swept floors for six years at TIT and eavesdropped on every course so that I wouldn't turn out like those two piles of garbage!

steps.name: Panicked Girl
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: And you! Don't you have anything better to do than put nagging notes on my bag? It's not like I don't know how to eat—

steps.name: Panicked Girl
steps.text: Those people are here again...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Frickin' hell... they just won't quit, will they? Stay behind me.

steps.name: Hoodlum A
steps.text: You think you're all high n' mighty wearin' that white coat, eh? You and that li'l bitch there will always be slum dregs, no matter what you wear.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Hah... you're a musbeast in a ditch. You wouldn't know greatness if it shat on your face.

steps.name: Hoodlum B
steps.text: Say that again, I dare you!

steps.name: Panicked Girl
steps.text: Andrew!

steps.name: Hoodlum A
steps.text: Wh-What's that?

steps.name: Hoodlum B
steps.text: Catastrophe?! Run!

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Catastrophe my ass! It's called exploration! Progress!
The young man, all bruised up, looks up at the sky. He forgets that he is in a dark and dirty alley, with a scared little girl behind him.
He cannot help but go after that ray of light in the sky.
Aren't you worried about the Control?
Like she ever needs us to worry.
We're going the same way. And that's all we are.
We can only play our own parts, and then... pray she's lucky.
(In Sarkaz) If one day, Kazdel too hangs from the firmament, then I'll engrave your name into my stoves.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: E-Excuse me, ma'am...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Can you tell me about the one who went into the sky...?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Who was that?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Kristen.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Her name was Kristen Wright.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Lucky Cystybeast Food and Beverage will cancel their registration tomorrow, Director.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: They didn't pass the re-check?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Not even close. They were one of the first corporations that made the transformation to get into Propeller Paradise, riding on 'sky fever', when review criteria were less strict—

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: What will happen to the testers they hired?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Their boss can't tell a motor from a transformer. I bet he just saw the name 'Propeller Paradise' as an opportunity to get rich quick...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: What were you asking?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Nothing. You seem to like the name.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I wish they would just call it Galleria Stellaria.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I know you didn't approve of publicizing the Ring Lab's technological legacy.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I have no intention of criticizing the Acting Control's decision, but overly conservative decision-making will only cause us to lose the respect we deserve.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Countless tech firms have appeared out of nowhere, based on nothing but speckles of data. The Ring Lab that shone upon millions of Columbians is now educational toys accessible to anyone above the age of five...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: 'Space' and 'universe' are the buzzwords on every Columbian's lips, but few remember that they came from Kristen's experiment logs that were made public.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: No one is truly commemorating her—not even you, Director Lunorey.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Recording and retrospection are historians' work. Our job is to analyze validated data and follow a path that is effective and proven.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: And what has come of this data and path?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Over the past couple of years, Rhine has acquired a dozen smaller labs, making progress in projects large and small—with the notable exception of Kristen's legacy.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: At this exhibition, we will publish Rhine's subsequent research into the Galleria Stellaria for the first time, putting second-rate tech firms in their place, returning to the realm of aero-exploration and the public eye.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I know the Vivarium was built on the data transmitted down from the Ring Lab, and that the development of a plant-based energy transmission system represents a monumental milestone in engineering design.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Nurturing sprouts, paving botanical units, technical inspections... all these are for the sake of progressing our experiments. But is a 'vivarium' really enough, when it did not even get its day in the sun from the pre-expo?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Please, tell me, Director Lunorey. Rhine has bigger goals, don't we? Like how no one knew that Kristen was going to pierce the sky before the night she did it?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: That night over Trimounts was a long time ago.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Get to inspecting the next company. Take note of the change in order.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Sky.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I know how you feel, and I know that Kristen was the one who inspired you to join us.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Many people looked up at the sky that night. Not everyone chose to chase it.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Don't forget what made you take the first step.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: ...I'll prepare the inspection documents.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Here's your pass, agreement form and business directory. Once again, I welcome you and your team on behalf of Propeller Paradise!

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Next! Can I help you?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I'm cancelling my business registration...

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: What is the name of the business?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Lucky Cystybeast Food and Beverage.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: You will be dismissing eighty-two testers, correct?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Yes, I have their files and my own here.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Thank you. One moment please.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Did the Shadow-Moon fall on my head or something? Why was I so sure I would make my money back that I hired eighty-two amateurs with no corporate experience?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Every company does the same thing. Why does it have to be Lucky Cystybeast that gets the axe?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: A million gold certificates down the drain just because we were a little bit slow dealing with problems? You gotta be freaking kidding me!

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: How the crap did One-Boot Shadow-Moon Real Estate solve that stupid '3D levitating boundary marker' technical issue? That bunch of cobblers?

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Your request has been processed, Mr. Aspen. The Propeller Paradise hotline will remain available until the end of the day.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: However, if you have certain 'special' needs, like One-Boot Shadow-Moon Real Estate did... we can help you with that.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: What do you mean?
The smiling staff member takes out the business directory that virtually everyone in Propeller Paradise has a copy of, and points to a phone number.
No name, no address, just an unremarkable phone number hidden among thousands, as tiny as Aspen's hope.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: One phone call to this number is gonna solve all my problems? Lucky Cystybeast won't have to leave Propeller Paradise?

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Then I want to withdraw the terminations and the cancellation of registration—

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: No need to worry. The registration of Lucky Cystybeast has not been cancelled. However, you do not need to withdraw the termination of your testers.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: This phone call will 'completely' solve your problems, and you won't need those people anymore.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: A miracle, or a scam...?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Screw it. Anything to stay up here.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Mr. Tannen.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Let me guess. Nasti was skeptical, but she accepted the list and agreed to the proposal?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Yes. I checked the Engineering Department's inspection schedule for today, and it's exactly in the order that you proposed.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: But how did you know?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I didn't know what she was going to choose. All I know was that I'm at the apex of my life right now, and everything is going my way!

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You're in good spirits.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: It's gonna take more than a Rhine director to move the needle.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Open the letter on the table.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: 'From: Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units, and Originium, To: Mr. Gordon Tannen. Congratulations on your appointment as Chief Executive of Propeller Paradise...'

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Two pages? I've never seen a congratulation letter this long.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: The reassignment letter that I got six months ago on the border was two lines.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Everyone thinks the ATAO is a sweet gig, but I didn't get to embezzle shit from the savages in Sami or the tribals in the Sargonian rainforest.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: The old fox hated me, and the rest of the ATAO turned their noses up at me. Now? He's retired, and I'm promoted. Things sure can change in a hurry, don't they?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: It's still light out, but a happy occasion like this calls for a—

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: A toast.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Your champagne, sir.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Well done, Merry. You've made some progress in your time with me, whether we're talking about Nasti or this glass. Pour one for yourself.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Thank you, sir. However, the Rules are quite clear about not drinking on the job.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Beastshit. I pulled that manual out of my ass.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: In that case... would you like to say a few words?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Yeah... the exhibition six days from now is just the start. My opening address will be the toast of all of Columbia.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Every rocket will have my face on it, and the largest district in Shadow-Moon will be named after me.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Rhine, ATAO, the District... no one's ever gonna tell Gordon Tannen what to do! This'll be my Propeller Paradise, forever and ever!

spans.text: Rhine, ATAO, the District... no one's ever gonna tell Gordon Tannen what to do! This'll be

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Bottoms-up!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Who are you? Here for the party?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Hello. Are you the Chief Executive of Propeller Paradise?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Oakley, newly appointed guide for Propeller Paradise. I'm supposed to report to a Mr. Gordon Tannen.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Pffft—!
Gordon Tannen spits the champagne out of his mouth.
